title: What If You Were Trapped in a Waterpark for 30 Days With Your Crush?
description:
What if you got invited to spend 30 days locked inside the biggest indoor waterpark in the world… for $100,000? 💦

There's just one catch: your partner is Maya — your crush for almost two years. At first it's paradise: giant slides, wave pools, late-night dinners by the water. But then the storm hits, the lights go out, the water starts rising… and Maya starts acting like she knows something you don't.

Strange questions. Locked doors. Hidden documents. A basement that's slowly flooding.
And a message from an unknown number that changes everything.

Would YOU trust Maya? Tell us in the comments! 👇

title: What If You Could Hear What Everyone Says Behind Your Back?
description:
What If You Could Hear What Everyone Says Behind Your Back?
Would you take it? Play this episode's round of the What If Card Game free →  https://whatifgame.site/d8

What if you could hear every word anyone says about you when you're not there? You get up from the lunch table, and three tables away a voice lands right behind your ear. It's your best friend. "Honestly? I can't stand him." When you get back to the table, he's saving you his pudding.

At first it's amazing. You find out your little sister thinks you're the best, though she'd never tell you. The girl behind you in science would say yes if you asked her to the dance, so you ask. You win class president by two hundred votes. You pull an old man's dog out of a pond, and that night two million strangers are talking about you at once. Then you hear the group chat.

Everybody talks about somebody who isn't there. One day, the voice you hear is your own.

Whose voice would you listen for first? Tell us in the comments.

Is any of this real? The science in this episode:
- The average person spends about 52 minutes a day talking about someone who isn't there, and almost three-quarters of it is neutral, not mean. 467 people wore recorders that sampled their everyday conversations. Robbins & Karan (2019), "Who Gossips and How in Everyday Life?", Social Psychological and Personality Science.
- When teens aged 13 to 18 saw photos with lots of likes, including their own photos, the brain's reward circuitry (the nucleus accumbens) was more active. Sherman, Payton, Hernandez, Greenfield & Dapretto (2016), "The Power of the Like in Adolescence", Psychological Science 27(7).
- When a story is passed from person to person, each retelling gets shorter and simpler, and a few details get sharper. Psychologists call it leveling and sharpening. Allport & Postman (1947), The Psychology of Rumor.
- When you say something bad about someone, the people listening start to connect that trait with you. Skowronski, Carlston, Mae & Crawford (1998), "Spontaneous Trait Transference: Communicators Take On the Qualities They Describe in Others", Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 74(4).

title: What If You Could Hear Your Crush While in a Coma?
description:
What if you were in a coma, unable to move or speak, but you could hear everything your crush said?

Every word. Every whisper. Every secret they thought you would never hear. Day after day, they sit beside you and talk about things they never had the courage to say when you were awake.

Follow the story of someone trapped in silence while the one person they liked most finally opens up. What would you learn about them, and about yourself? And what would you do with the truth if you woke up?

Would you want to hear it, or would some words be better left unheard? Tell me in the comments!

Subscribe for the next story: what happens when your everyday life takes a strange turn.

title: What If You Could See Everyone's Real-Life Rating?
description:
One morning, a player rating card appears above everyone's head. And it's always right.

Mine says 41. The captain everyone worships is a 71. And the kid who gets picked last every single time? He's a 94!

So I build a team out of everyone the school ignored, and bet everything on Saturday's cup. Then we lose 6–0, and I find out the rating doesn't measure everything. 

What would YOUR rating be? Tell me in the comments 👇

title: What If Your College Assigned Your CRUSH as Your Wife?
tags: what if your college assigned you a wife
description:
Your college just sent your roommate assignment. Roommate: Lia. Relationship: wife. It's a "Partner Housing Pilot" you accepted without reading, there is only one bed, and the rules are simple: stay officially married for one year, no annulments, and keep your weekly compatibility score above 50% or you both lose the room. One problem: somebody on campus is trying to make your marriage fail.

Two questions for the comments:
1) Who did you think the saboteur was: Brett, Maya or Jake? Be honest.
2) Day 100, the annulment form is on your desk. Do you sign it or tear it up?

Subscribe before your compatibility score drops below 50%. Lia checks.

Real fact in this episode: in 1950, an MIT study of the Westgate housing complex found that people were far more likely to become friends with whoever lived just a few doors down. Closer door, closer friend.

title: What If You and Your Crush Were the Last Two Humans Alive?
description:
What if Earth suddenly exploded, and the only person you managed to escape with was your crush? 🌍🚀 Imagine working at a rocket station when every alarm suddenly starts going off. You have just ten minutes before Earth is destroyed. You rush into the last available spaceship, but just as you’re about to launch, someone comes running toward you. It’s the girl you’ve secretly liked for years! Seconds later, you’re flying through space together, watching your entire planet disappear.In this animated what-if scenario, we imagine what would happen if you and your crush became the last two humans alive. With limited food, almost no fuel, and nowhere to call home, your only hope is a mysterious alien planet three days away. But what happens when you land on a beautiful new world filled with glowing forests, purple mountains, strange creatures, and two enormous moons?At first, surviving together seems impossible. You have to find food, build shelter, explore dangerous environments, and somehow avoid embarrassing yourself in front of your crush. But as the days pass, something unexpected happens. Between hilarious accidents, romantic evenings, and adopting an adorable alien creature named Biscuit, you slowly begin falling in love. 💕But this planet is hiding something incredible. Mysterious footprints appear near your camp, dangerous storms threaten your survival, and an ancient alien spaceship reveals a secret that could change humanity’s future forever. Could other humans have survived Earth’s destruction? And what happens when you discover that your new home might not be as empty as you thought?Over 30 unforgettable days, you and your crush must work together to survive, uncover the planet’s mysteries, and decide whether to leave your new world behind. Could losing everything somehow lead to finding the person you’ve always wanted to be with?If you enjoyed this adventure, check out our other videos:💘 What If Your Crush Confessed to You Every Day?🧠 What If Everyone Could Hear Your Thoughts?✨ What If You Could Master Anything Instantly?💕 What If You Could See Everyone’s Real Attractiveness?🪐 What If You and Your Crush Were the Only People on a Planet?☄️ What If You Had Only 7 Days Left on Earth With Your Crush?Here’s the real question: If Earth exploded tomorrow and you could only save ONE person, who would you choose? Your crush, your best friend, or someone from your family?Tell us in the comments, and subscribe to help us reach our first 100 subscribers! title: What If You Could See Everyone's Biggest Regret?
description:
What if you could see everyone's biggest regret floating above their heads? 👀💔

At first, it's hilarious. People regretting bad relationships, missed opportunities, and terrible decisions.

But everything changes when you look at your own father and see just two words above his head…

**MY SON.** 💔

Would you really want to know what the people closest to you regret most? 🥺

title: What If You Could See How Many Lives Everyone Has Saved?
description:
What if you could see how many lives every person has saved? 👀

Some people have saved hundreds. Others haven't saved a single one. But when Alex discovers an ordinary school janitor with **999+ lives saved**, he uncovers a story nobody expected.

Sometimes the biggest heroes are the ones nobody notices.

🔔 Subscribe for more animated What If stories!

title: What If U Could Pick Your Strength Every Morning?
tags: what if you could pick your strength
what if you were super strong
description:
You buy an old alarm clock at a garage sale. It has a dial on the side, from one pound to a thousand tons, and whatever you set in the morning is how much you can lift all day. On Monday you lift the school bus. On Tuesday you carry your whole house to the lake. But the strength doesn't come with control, and the one person you most want to hug is your little sister.

title: What If Men and Women Lived on Different Planets?
tags: what if men and women lived on different planets
men are from mars women are from venus
description:
What if men and women got so tired of arguing that every woman on Earth moved to Venus and every man moved to Mars? One night in 2067, four hundred million couples couldn't agree where to eat. The next morning, the world voted to split up.

Floating cloud cities with eleven pillows on every couch. Lava-tube man caves with a TV on every wall. Brunch and book clubs against beer, football and a barbecue that won't light on a planet with no oxygen. Then a dust storm swallows Mars, the batteries start running out, and the men have to do the one thing they never do: ask for help.

Would you move to Venus, to Mars, or stay on Earth and pick dinner yourself? Tell us in the comments 👇
